prompt.zh-TW: 木岸家具年底流動資產 {{money:vars.ca}}（其中現金 {{money:vars.cash}}、應收帳款 {{money:vars.ar}}、短期放款 {{money:vars.loans}}，其餘是存貨），流動負債 {{money:vars.cl}}。流動比率從去年的 {{number:vars.last|digits=2,unit=times}} 升到今年的 {{number:vars.now|digits=2,unit=times}}，速動比率兩年都是 {{number:vars.quick|digits=2,unit=times}}（見上表）。哪一個判讀最合理？
prompt.en: Woodbank Furniture has current assets of {{money:vars.ca}} at year end (cash {{money:vars.cash}}, trade receivables {{money:vars.ar}}, short-term loans receivable {{money:vars.loans}}, the rest inventory) and current liabilities of {{money:vars.cl}}. The current ratio rose from {{number:vars.last|digits=2,unit=times}} last year to {{number:vars.now|digits=2,unit=times}} this year, while the quick ratio was {{number:vars.quick|digits=2,unit=times}} in both years (see the table above). Which reading is most reasonable?

text.zh-TW: 增加的流動資產幾乎都是存貨，接著該看存貨週轉率
text.en: Almost all of the extra current assets are inventory; check inventory turnover next

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。兩個指標的差別就是存貨；速動比率沒動，表示真正能快速變現的部分沒有改善。
feedback.en: That’s right. The difference between the two ratios is inventory; an unchanged quick ratio means the part that can quickly become cash has not improved.

text.zh-TW: 流動比率上升，可以放心再借一筆短期借款
text.en: The current ratio rose, so it is safe to take out another short-term loan

feedback.zh-TW: 流動比率上升確實是往好的方向，這點沒錯。不過速動比率沒變，表示多出來的流動資產是存貨；存貨賣不掉就還不了錢，這時再加借短期借款，壓力只會更大。
feedback.en: A higher current ratio is indeed the right direction. But the unchanged quick ratio shows the extra current assets are inventory; unsold inventory cannot repay debts, so taking on more short-term borrowing now would only add to the pressure.

text.zh-TW: 速動比率沒變，表示流動比率的數字算錯了
text.en: The quick ratio did not change, so the current ratio must have been calculated wrongly

feedback.zh-TW: 兩個指標的分子不同，一個含存貨、一個不含，走勢不同是正常的；這個差異正好是交叉檢查的線索，不是計算錯誤。
feedback.en: The two ratios have different numerators, one with inventory and one without, so diverging trends are normal; the gap is exactly the cross-checking clue, not a calculation error.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_c8r1t4zm}}與{{term:tm_n8ysnw1m}}只差一個{{term:tm_n7v3k8pq}}。{{option:o_mfgw}}用兩者的差異找到原因；{{option:o_njax}}只看一個指標，{{option:o_hsc1}}把線索當成錯誤。
explanation.en: The {{term:tm_c8r1t4zm}} and the {{term:tm_n8ysnw1m}} differ only by {{term:tm_n7v3k8pq}}. {{option:o_mfgw}} uses that difference to find the cause; {{option:o_njax}} looks at one ratio alone, and {{option:o_hsc1}} mistakes the clue for an error.
